title: net2 gate, round 7t: round 7's students acting on p past 0.4
description: Round 7's gate3 students (exp-net2-r7-gate3-124) learned to recognize copies (q 0.55 to 0.72 with copies, 0.21 to 0.26 elsewhere, over their last 10 training iterations) and lost nothing to the fixed rule as copies on average (exp-net2-gate-r7-125: -0.012 for the kept candidate), but most of the push against Cubic went: +0.051 (-0.086 to +0.184) with Cubic from the start, where rounds 4 to 6b had +0.079 to +0.146. Their switch acted on p, the belief in a stock TCP flow, only past t = 0.5, and p was 0.63 to 0.72 where a stock TCP flow ran but only 0.21 to 0.35 where copies did, so a lower threshold on p restores the push with little push among copies. Here the same six students are exported by experiments/gate_threshold_export.py with the threshold on p at 0.4 and on q, the belief in copies, at 0.5 as trained; the thresholds 0.3 and 0.4 were fixed before either gate ran, and each gets its own gate because the rule keeps the best five-family mean, which leaves copies out. Policies in release model-net2-r7t04-cands. They run next to the fixed rule on net1 v5 (u = 0.25, release model-net1v5) and BBRv3 on the five validation families and as 2 and 4 copies for 30 s, with campaign seed 21. The share rule at k = 0.5 and 1 on net1 v5 also runs, as a reference and not a candidate: it is what the teacher does wherever a stock TCP flow is active, so with the fixed rule it bounds what the student can reach. The rule is unchanged (experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py): per link, the mean over a candidate's seeds of its log utility minus the rule's; the candidate kept has the highest five-family mean; the gate passes if it beats the rule in cubic-first-60 and in new-20's competition conditions, each with its 95% interval over links above 0, is at or above the rule on the five-family mean, and is not worse with copies beyond its interval. A candidate that passes runs once on the test links. Validation links only.
prepare: (cd "$IN/c" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); (cd "$IN/m" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); uv run python experiments/share_rule_export.py "$OUT/share" "$IN/m/net1v5.pt" --u0 0.25 --k 0.5 1; P=(--policy "rule-v5=$IN/m/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "share-k0.5=$OUT/share/share-u0.25-k0.5.onnx" --policy "share-k1=$OUT/share/share-u0.25-k1.onnx"); for f in "$IN"/c/ppo-*.onnx; do P+=(--policy "$(basename "$f" .onnx)=$f"); done; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s && mv "$OUT/summary.md" "$OUT/against-bbr3.md" && uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py "$OUT"
